mainEntity.name: How much does a BMW X5 45e engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A BMW X5 45e engine replacement typically costs £5,000-£9,000 supply-only for rebuilt units, or £6,500-£10,500 fitted by a specialist. The B58 hybrid system adds complexity compared to non-hybrid X5s. Used B58B30C engines: £3,000-£5,500 supply-only. Reconditioned units: £5,500-£8,500 supply-only. Professional fitting adds £1,000-£1,800 depending on workshop location. Hybrid system recalibration is required after engine replacement.

mainEntity.name: How reliable is the BMW X5 45e B58 hybrid engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The B58 petrol engine is widely regarded as BMW's most reliable modern engine. However, the 45e's hybrid system adds complexity. The primary long-term concern is high-voltage battery degradation after 5-7 years or 100,000 km. B58-standard issues include oil filter housing gasket leaks and water pump failure. B58 engine itself is exceptionally reliable - closed-deck design, robust internals. High-voltage battery is the main long-term cost concern. Hybrid cooling system requires specialist maintenance. Regular servicing (including hybrid system checks) extends component life.

mainEntity.name: How long does the BMW X5 45e high-voltage battery last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 21.6 kWh lithium-ion battery typically lasts 8-10 years or 100,000-150,000 miles. However, degradation begins after 5-7 years or 60,000-100,000 km, with reduced electric-only range being the first symptom. BMW offers an 8-year/100,000-mile warranty on the high-voltage battery (check your vehicle). Capacity loss of 20-30% is typical after 8 years. Reconditioned battery packs offer a cost-effective alternative to dealer replacement. Regular use and proper charging habits extend battery life.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water pump failure in a BMW X5 45e?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common signs are coolant loss without visible external leaks, rising engine temperature, warning lights on the dashboard, and in severe cases, the vehicle shutting down completely. The 45e's cooling system also manages hybrid component temperatures. Low coolant warning is the earliest sign. Engine temperature gauge rising above normal. Whining noise from the front of the engine. Hybrid system warning lights may also appear.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine or battery on a high-mileage BMW X5 45e?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a 45e worth £35,000-£52,000, a rebuilt B58 engine at £5,000-£9,000 or a reconditioned battery at £5,000-£8,500 can make financial sense if the rest of the vehicle is in excellent condition. Compare replacement cost against vehicle value - specialist advice: replacement viable up to 70% of car's value. High-voltage battery replacement is often worthwhile given the vehicle's retained value. Factor 12-month warranty into replacement decision. Always get a full vehicle inspection before committing to major work.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between the BMW X5 45e and the newer 50e?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 50e replaced the 45e in 2023 with significantly more power (489hp vs 394hp) and a larger battery. Both use the B58 petrol engine as the combustion basis, but the 50e has a more powerful electric motor and improved hybrid system. 45e: 394hp combined, 21.6 kWh battery, 54-mile electric range. 50e: 489hp combined, 25.7 kWh battery, 67-mile electric range. Both share the same B58 engine architecture. 50e parts and replacement costs are currently higher due to newer technology.

historyTimeline.h2: BMW X5 45e - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: Launched in 2019 as part of the fourth-generation G05 X5 range, the xDrive45e replaced the earlier F15 xDrive40e with a significantly more powerful and refined plug-in hybrid powertrain. Combining BMW's acclaimed B58 3.0-litre turbocharged straight-six petrol engine with an electric motor integrated into the eight-speed automatic gearbox, the 45e delivered 394hp and an electric-only range of up to 54 miles - a substantial leap over its predecessor.

milestones.description: G05 X5 xDrive45e launched, B58B30C 3.0-litre turbo petrol (286hp) + 83kW electric motor (113hp), 394hp combined, 21.6kWh battery
B58B30M1 engine code introduced for some markets; system power unchanged
Minor software updates for improved electric range and charging behaviour
Production continues with no major mechanical changes
xDrive50e replaces 45e with 489hp and larger battery; 45e production ends
present - 45e enters the used market; replacement demand grows as early examples pass 60,000-80,000 miles

commonProblems.h2: BMW X5 45e Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The BMW X5 45e combines the renowned B58 3.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine with an electric motor and 21.6 kWh battery. While the B58 is widely regarded as BMW's most reliable modern petrol engine, the hybrid system introduces additional complexity and potential failure points. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components addressing the original failure points - plus a minimum 12-month unlimited mileage warranty.

problems.h4: High-Voltage Battery Degradation - Why the BMW X5 45e Loses Electric Range
problems.rootCause: The 21.6 kWh lithium-ion high-voltage battery degrades over time due to charge cycles, heat exposure, and age. Capacity loss manifests as reduced electric-only range, longer charging times, and decreased electric motor assistance.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace individual degraded battery modules; requires specialist hybrid workshop
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if only one or two modules have failed

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Complete battery pack replacement; includes BMS recalibration
repairOptions.longevity: Required for extensive degradation; independent specialists offer significant savings

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical BMW X5 45e is worth £35,000-£52,000 depending on age, mileage, and specification. Given the high vehicle value, battery replacement is generally viable even at the upper end of the cost range. However, on higher-mileage examples approaching 80,000 miles, evaluate the vehicle's overall condition before committing to a full battery replacement.
problems.recommendation: For a 45e you plan to keep long-term, a specialist battery module replacement or reconditioned battery pack offers the best value - often half the dealer price. If the battery is still under the 8-year/100,000-mile BMW high-voltage warranty (check your specific vehicle), replacement may be covered. For examples with extensive battery degradation and other issues, a full specialist replacement at £5,000-£8,500 is significantly more cost-effective than dealer pricing.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW X5 45e hybrid battery replacement costs

problems.group: B58 Oil Filter Housing Gasket Leak
problems.h4: B58 Oil Filter Housing Gasket Leak - Why the BMW X5 45e Loses Oil
problems.rootCause: The oil filter housing gasket on the B58 engine becomes brittle over time, allowing oil to seep past. This is a well-documented BMW issue across the B58 family. Symptoms include visible oil around the housing, a burning oil smell, and low oil levels.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace gasket, clean housing area, oil top-up
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught early; 50,000-80,000 mile interval

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt B58 engine with upgraded gaskets, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if oil starvation caused bearing damage

problems.recommendation: This is a relatively straightforward repair that should be addressed immediately. Ignoring an oil filter housing gasket leak can lead to oil starvation and catastrophic engine failure. At £350-£600 at a specialist, it's cheap insurance for a £35,000+ vehicle.
problems.cta: -> Get quotes for BMW X5 45e oil filter housing gasket repair

problems.h4: B58 Water Pump Failure - Why the BMW X5 45e Overheats
problems.rootCause: The B58's electric water pump can fail prematurely, leading to coolant loss and overheating. Owners have reported water pump failure while driving, with the vehicle shutting down completely. The 45e's cooling system is more complex than non-hybrid models, as it must also manage hybrid component temperatures.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace electric water pump, coolant flush, system bleed
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if caught before overheating; 40,000-70,000 mile interval

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit rebuilt B58 engine with new cooling components, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Required if overheating caused head gasket or cylinder head damage

problems.recommendation: On any 45e approaching 50,000 miles, proactive water pump replacement is cheap insurance. The B58 is an aluminium-block engine - overheating can warp the cylinder head, leading to a repair bill that quickly exceeds the vehicle's remaining value. Check coolant levels monthly and address any warning lights immediately.
problems.cta: -> Compare BMW X5 45e water pump replacement costs

problems.group: Hybrid Cooling System & Electric Coolant Pump Failure
problems.h4: Hybrid Cooling System & Electric Coolant Pump Failure
problems.rootCause: The 45e's cooling system must manage temperatures for the combustion engine, electric motor, battery, and power electronics. The electric coolant pump can fail, and coolant leaks can develop in the hybrid cooling circuit. Symptoms include rising operating temperatures of hybrid components, warning lights, and reduced hybrid performance.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace electric coolant pump, hybrid cooling system flush
Replace pump, hoses, expansion tank, coolant flush, hybrid system recalibration
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended on high-mileage 45e as preventative maintenance

problems.recommendation: The hybrid cooling system is more complex than on non-hybrid X5s. Any warning lights related to hybrid system temperature should be investigated immediately. Specialist diagnosis is essential - main dealer diagnostics can be costly, but independent BMW hybrid specialists offer more competitive rates.
